description: An upright candle has a straight-sided body, softly rounded top corners and a flat base. A short vertical wick rises from its centre into a pointed teardrop flame above.
A round light bulb narrows through curved shoulders into a short rounded base, separated by a horizontal seam. Five short rays spread above and beside the blank glass globe.
A tall light bulb has a rounded glass globe tapering into a narrow neck. A horizontal seam separates the glass from a short base with a smoothly rounded bottom.
A broad rounded glass bulb narrows through curved shoulders into a short neck. The blank globe sits above a shallow rounded base, with a straight horizontal seam between them.
A broad light bulb has a rounded dome and inward-curving sides that narrow toward its neck. A short rounded base sits beneath a horizontal seam across the bottom of the glass.
A small round bulb contains a Y-shaped filament above a rounded base with a short lower contact. Two broad nested wireless arcs span the open space directly above the globe.
